ideas.title: Investigating the Use of Force by Law Enforcement
ideas.description: This story would investigate the use of force by law enforcement, particularly in cases involving immigrants.
ideas.angle: The specific investigative angle would be to examine the policies and procedures in place for the use of force and whether they are being followed.
questions: What are the policies and procedures in place for the use of force by law enforcement?
Are these policies and procedures being followed?
searches: use of force by law enforcement
ideas.insight: This story is important because it highlights the need for accountability and transparency in law enforcement. By investigating the use of force, we can identify patterns and connections that may indicate a larger problem.
